messages.author: e498b38f01df2491
messages.subject: error in besag models: cpo$failure=1
parts:
Dear all,

I am fitting some besag models and I am computing DIC as well as CPO.
I expected to do a model selection. So, I fitted a model with all the covariates, and then I am removing one by one according to: covariate posterior covers the zero, or mean posterior closer to zero. In addition, with the model fitted I would plot the predicted values.
Nevertheless, the results of cpo$failure are all 1.

I have already tried the option:

improved.result <- inla.cpo(result12, verbose=T), but I received the message: "Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please       rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>."

I am using the following model:

ldat12 <- list(y=ygrupos, i=ind,
               zm=zm[ind], ventop=ventop[ind],
               plataformas=factor(plataformas[ind]),
               logJ=log(J[ind]))

m12 <- y ~ f(i, model="besag", graph=g) + zm + ventop + plataformas

result12 <- inla(m12, family="poisson", data=ldat12, offset=logJ,
                 control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=T), quantiles=c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))  

I appreciate any help with this issue.

Best regards,
Heloise
